text:
sam_support: Escalating urgent onboarding/activation blocker for NovaPort (acct NP-452). Trial user — renewal touchpoint in 10 days. Seeing intermittent 500/502 errors on embed ingest, started ~11:00 PST, ~12 failures in last 2 hours. Support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5567. P1. Need CS to own customer comms + renewal risk flag.

anita_cs: Thanks @sam_support — I'm taking this. Can you paste the most recent error and the exact requests that failed? Also need customer contact + preferred SLA expectations.

sam_support: Copy of last error from logs:
```
ERROR embed-service request_id=ff12ac status=502 backend=route-mgr timeout=12000ms
stack: com.redwood.embed.ReadTimeoutException at EmbedRouter.handle(EmbedRouter.java:233)
```
Failed calls are to /v1/embeddings with batch size 64. Customer contact: jo@novaport.io (CTO), prefers daily updates until fixed. Trial ends in 10 days and they're evaluating cost + latency — high renewal risk if unstable.

kevin_eng: Looking. Early note: these 502s look like upstream routing timeouts when KV cache miss + long seq lengths. I spun up an extra pool in staging to reproduce. @infra-bot can you confirm any recent routing config changes in prod around 10:45 PST?

infra-bot: prod-config-deploy: routing-config v3.12 applied at 10:41 PST to us-west-2. No infra incidents reported. Autoscaler added 1 GPU node at 10:59 PST.

anita_cs: Proposed comms plan draft:
- Immediate: ack to customer within 30m, apologize, say we're investigating and will provide daily updates.
- Short-term mitigation: ask them to reduce batch size to 8-16 and retry (we'll provide sample curl). This mitigates most failures.
- Mid-term: eng to verify routing timeout root cause + rollback or tune if config change caused regression.
- Renewal handling: flag account as "at-risk" in CRM, schedule a 30-min status call with Jo within 24 hours (propose 9am PST tomorrow).

sam_support: Confirmed workaround reduces failures in test. Sample retry curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-large","input": ["..."], "batch_size": 8}'
```

tariq_enable: I'll prep a one-pager for the call focusing on expected latency, recommended batch sizes, and how attribution/crediting works for trials. Also can run a quick live demo of retry flow.

anita_cs: Internal action items (owners):
- sam_support: continue ticket updates to customer + attach logs (owner)
- kevin_eng: investigate routing-config impact and rollback plan (owner)
- infra-bot / kevin_eng: verify autoscaler behavior and node provisioning timing (owner)
- tariq_enable: prep enablement one-pager + demo (owner)
- anita_cs: schedule status call, update CRM flag to "risk: high" and create renewal alert

kevin_eng: Initial triage: reproduces under high seq length + full-batch ingestion. Hypothesis: kernel selection path + cache miss leads to slow startup on some instances causing request timeouts. I have a canary fix ready (reduce initial kernel init timeout) — I'll test in staging and, if green, push a quick hotfix and rollback routing-config if needed.

anita_cs: Messaging to customer (short template):
"Hi Jo — thanks for flagging this. We're seeing intermittent embed failures affecting ingestion. We've identified a likely routing timeout under certain batch/seq combos. Short-term workaround: reduce batch_size to 8. Our engineers are testing a fix now; we'll update you tomorrow morning and remain on standby for a quick call. — Anita, Redwood CS"

sam_support: Sent to Jo at 11:30 PST and linked to ticket (CS-5567). Jo acknowledged and accepted 9am PST call tomorrow. She asked for ETA on fix — replied "24-36h if canary looks good."

anita_cs: OK owners confirmed. kevin, please post canary results here. sam, keep daily updates in ticket and ping me for any change in tone. tariq, please attach enablement doc to the call invite.

kevin_eng: Canary results: reduced init timeout fixed reproducible failure in staging. No regressions observed in perf smoke. I'm scheduling a hotfix deploy to prod at 14:00 PST with a 15-min maintenance window; will monitor metrics and rollback if errors spike.

anita_cs: Noted. I'll add a brief pre-call update to Jo's calendar invite and mark the CRM renewal flag. If deploy goes well, we'll schedule a follow-up 1-week check-in after trial ends.

sam_support: Will keep ticket thread updated. Thanks team.

tariq_enable: Added enablement slide deck to calendar invite and will join the 9am call.

anita_cs: Closing internal thread for now — re-open if deploy fails or customer escalates. :white_check_mark:
